label: estimate, not a certified footprint
scope: Cradle-to-gate primary material production for materials with a published category factor, plus the transport legs the buyer enters. The material factors already include transport to the point of sale, so entered legs may overlap them. Excludes use, end of life, packaging, warehousing and supplier-specific data.
